name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 1"

env:
  UV_NO_SYNC: true
  INLINE_SNAPSHOT_DEFAULT_FLAGS: review

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    env:
      UV_PYTHON: "3.10"
      UV_RESOLUTION: lowest-direct
      STARLETTE_SRC: starlette-pypi
    steps:
      - name: Dump GitHub context
        env:
          GITHUB_CONTEXT: ${{ toJson(github) }}
        run: echo "$GITHUB_CONTEXT"
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
      - name: Setup uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: |
            pyproject.toml
            uv.lock
      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all
      - name: Ensure that we have the lowest supported Pydantic version
        run: uv pip install "pydantic==2.9.0"
      - run: mkdir coverage
      - name: Test
        run: uv run --no-sync bash scripts/test-cov.sh
        env:
          COVERAGE_FILE: coverage/.coverage.macOS-py3.10
          CONTEXT: macOS-py3.10
      - name: Store coverage files
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: coverage-macOS-3.10-${{ hashFiles('**/coverage/.coverage.*') }}
          path: coverage
          include-hidden-files: true
